Page 202 Cont.
Apr. 10 Dan Stephenson - 6 - Highland Park Hospital - fell last evening into basement of a new house when it seems the children were playing - Con- cussion of brain feared.
10 John Hink of Wyandotte - 18 - cut his arm badly - loss of arm feared - Storm window
John & Eliz. M. Reel - just last July married - now misunderstanding .divorce threatened
11 Emma Bockheim - 64 - diabetis - gall stones - etc ....
11 Julia McConnell - 54 - inward cancer - in Grace Hospital - quite threatening ..... Enrolled To-day 5.00
Page 203
Apr. 11 Mrs. Virginia Eisenach - 26 - Spinal troubel - partially paralyzed -
Richard Decker - 19 - shot in Eye with a baby-gun by a little neighbor boy of three years. That was 4 yrs ago; has still trouble and serious head-aches ...
Mrs. Mary Lamentier - 45 - of Chicago - diabetis and complication - Mother of 15 ... two daughter nuns here in Detroit asks for prayers - also for her parents who lost heavily in depression and find it diffi- cult to carry on ... for peace in Fam.
Mr. Ellis R. Louis - 53 - abscess - both Lungs - Windsor
June Arnet - 17 - serious sight failure. Just graduating in Hi. and hoping to go to Marygrove.
E'd Jepko - 40 - Heart enlargment - Mother's sole support
15
Helen M. Wajda - 9 - fearful case of Eczma .... of Centerline
15 Leonard Bonsall - 32 - lost foot - Drs. hope to save the other fear- fully crushed and smashed, by tons of iron ... Enrolled To-day
Page 204 Apr. 15 Mrs. Butler - in 50's - fearfully cancerous at 468 Cadieux Road - prayed for some time ago .... was told of a priest who had unfortunately become adicted to drink ... little by little lost out till working as a common laborer spoke in dispair ..... The patient has offered all her pains for conversion of same priest ... He has recently gone back to confession and is shortly to return to Bishop.
